data.name: Hotel Hacienda Vallarta Playa Las Glorias
data.address: Lucerna 103, Versalles, 48310 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
A 12-minute walk from Camarones Beach along
Pacific Ocean, this casual hotel within a shopping plaza is 3 km from the Malecón esplanade. It's 6 km from the Licenciado Gustavo Díaz Ordaz International Airport.
The informal rooms and suites, with streamlined decor and colorful accents, feature cable TVs and free Wi-Fi. Room service is available.
Amenities include a casual restaurant with open-air dining, along with an outdoor pool. Breakfast is available for a fee.
